# VilouraAI

> VilouraAI is an AI agency for small businesses in Dallas–Fort Worth, based in Lewisville, Texas. We build new mobile-first websites, answer every call with an AI receptionist, and show owners their next 12 weeks of bookings with a free forecast. No contracts on the receptionist; the website is yours once built.

## Services

- Website Launch — $497 one-time. A mobile-first 5-page website (home, services, about, reviews, contact/booking), online booking button, Google Business Profile tune-up, basic local SEO. Live in 7 days. Optional care plan $29/mo.
- AI Receptionist — $149/mo. Answers every call 24/7 in a natural voice, books appointments, answers FAQs, texts the owner a summary after every call, missed-call text-back. No setup fee, cancel anytime, first 14 days free.
- Launch Bundle — $597. Website Launch plus the first month of AI Receptionist plus a Prisqo AI-visibility report ($19 value). First 10 founding clients pay $497, receptionist locked at $129/mo for 12 months.
- Free SEO audit — complimentary, no obligation. A one-page audit of a business's website: titles and descriptions, local SEO and Google Business Profile, speed and mobile, and AI visibility. Delivered by email. Request it at https://vilouraai.com/free-seo-audit
- Booking forecast — free 12-week forecast built on the owner's numbers; $495 Forecast Sprint for the 90-day deep dive.

## Who it is for

Dentists, salons and barbers, HVAC and plumbers, auto repair shops, med spas, and new businesses across Dallas–Fort Worth — Dallas, Fort Worth, Plano, Frisco, Arlington, and Lewisville.
